metadata.name: context-map-materializer
metadata.description: Run the Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for a corpus_key. Fetches unprocessed events, calls two LLM passes, and atomically updates the context map.

max_event_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for event input to the Distiller.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget for the context map.

parent_skeleton:
# Skill: context-map-materializer

Runs the full Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for one corpus.
Safe to run multiple times; idempotent already-processed events are skipped.

context_map_materializer.name: context_map_materializer
context_map_materializer.description: Runs the full Distiller -> Cartographer -> Evictor pipeline for one corpus. Safe to run multiple times; idempotent already-processed events are skipped.

max_event_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for event input to the Distiller.

token_budget.description: Maximum token budget for the context map.

side_effects: may update or create context map stored somewhere
preconditions: corpus_key refers to an existing and accessible corpus
required tools (Distiller, Cartographer, Evictor) are available
postconditions: context map for the specified corpus is materialized
previously processed events are skipped due to idempotency

error_conditions.recovery_hint: Verify corpus_key and ensure corpus connection is available.

error_conditions.condition: Pipeline tool not available (Distiller, Cartographer, Evictor)
error_conditions.recovery_hint: Install missing component or check PATH.
